about_short_description.short_description: Apoxy develops proxy platform for improving the security and usability of application programming interface and services.

product.name: Apoxy Proxy Platform
product.description: A programmable proxy platform that enhances security, observability, and usability of APIs and services by enabling custom operational logic through code rather than configuration.

product.name: Site-to-Site Connectivity with WireGuard Tunnels
product.description: A service providing secure, instant site-to-site connectivity using WireGuard tunnels for HTTP, TCP, or UDP traffic without complex firewall or VPC peering setups.

identifier.value: Custom Logic Deployment at the Edge

product.name: Custom Logic Deployment at the Edge
product.description: A feature allowing deployment of custom TypeScript or Go filters as WebAssembly modules at the network edge to extend proxy functionality.

product.name: API Observability and Logging
product.description: Tools for monitoring API usage and performance with native support for OpenTelemetry and Jaeger, schema-less log indexing, and sub-second query capabilities for troubleshooting.

product.name: Traffic and Security Management Features
product.description: Capabilities including instant TLS for any domain, flexible traffic management, global rate limiting, centralized access logs, custom security policies, and quota management.
